text.title: Framework Major Upgrade Inventory Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable upgrade signals to a rule from `content/01-core-rules.xml`. Every leaf names either a concrete rule id or `skip-this-methodology` when the case is out of scope. Max depth = 2.

decision-tree.root-question: How many major versions separate the currently deployed framework version from the target?

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology: a minor or patch bump does not need a forensics inventory; run the suite with deprecation warnings enabled and proceed
apply r-fmui-one-major-step-per-inventory: split into one inventory per major step in the vendor's documented order

branch.question: Which of the inventory's sections is missing or unverified: vendor-cited breaking-change map, deprecation-warning run, call-site counts, codemod classification, dependent-package compatibility, runtime prerequisites, two-axis risk scores, or none?

conclusion.verdict: apply r-fmui-breaking-change-cited-to-vendor: rebuild the map from vendor release notes for every minor between current and target
apply r-fmui-deprecation-warnings-as-errors: run the suite on the current version with warnings elevated to errors and add every warning as an entry
apply r-fmui-call-site-count-per-change: attach a reproducible search and its hit count to every entry
apply r-fmui-codemod-coverage-classified: classify each change codemod or manual with the tool, command and dry-run diff size
apply r-fmui-dependent-package-compatibility: table every framework-dependent package with its compatible version; mark blockers
apply r-fmui-runtime-prerequisites-listed: list target prerequisites against every environment; schedule runtime upgrades first
apply r-fmui-risk-scored-on-two-axes: score blast radius and detectability; write characterisation tests for untested runtime changes
skip-this-methodology: the inventory is complete; hand it to the reviewer and open the upgrade branch for this single major step

text.example: Observable: Django 4.2 to 5.0, major_gap == 1; map cited, deprecation run done, but three plugins have no 5.0-compatible release and are not marked blocker → gap == 'dependent_packages' → conclusion: r-fmui-dependent-package-compatibility.
